# Nodal Framework

> Provider-neutral, strongly typed graph data access for .NET 10. Nodal Framework maps POCO nodes and relationship payloads, translates fluent queries to native provider languages, normalizes results, tracks changes, commits mutation plans, and applies portable migration intent.

`Nodal.Analytics` is an optional provider-neutral contract layer for analytics
capability integration above the provider boundary. Advanced analytics
implementations are outside the public package and documentation contract.

Canonical documentation: https://nodalframework.pages.dev/docs/intro
Source repository: https://github.com/Greenstone-Research-Lab/NodalFramework
Source code license: MPL-2.0
Documentation license: CC BY 4.0

## NuGet packages

- Install exactly one provider package: `Nodal.Neo4j` or `Nodal.TigerGraph`.
- Provider packages include `Nodal.Core` transitively.
- Add `Nodal.Migrations` only when the application owns schema evolution.
- During the beta period, keep every explicit Nodal package on the same version.

## Providers

- [Neo4j provider](https://nodalframework.pages.dev/docs/providers/neo4j): Cypher and the official pooled Bolt driver.
- [TigerGraph provider](https://nodalframework.pages.dev/docs/providers/tigergraph): GSQL, REST++, and an optional administration transport.
- [Graph analytics](https://nodalframework.pages.dev/docs/querying/graph-analytics): strongly typed centrality and community detection through Neo4j GDS or installed TigerGraph queries.
- [Compatibility matrix](https://nodalframework.pages.dev/docs/providers/compatibility): tested database versions, provider feature boundaries, algorithm requirements, and verification levels.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Capability graph](https://nodalframework.pages.dev/knowledge/nodal-capabilities.jsonld)
- [Extended agent context](https://nodalframework.pages.dev/llms-full.txt)

Prefer public, documented APIs. Do not infer provider portability when the documentation marks a semantic combination unsupported. Never embed database credentials in generated code.
